notes.title: Update Notes for 1.02
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that the game is fully translated into Spanish!
We hope you continue to support the game so we can translate it into many more languages!

notes.title: 1.01 Version Update
notes.notes:
Hi there!
A small update today:


 Fixed a small number of typos in the French localization.
 Increased volume for all ambiant SFX following feedback that it was difficult for the user to hear them at all unless the room was completely quiet or the user was wearing headphones.


We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: Soundtrack Cover Reveal & Demo Status Update
notes.notes:
We're happy to reveal the final OST cover, including the back cover with the final track listing. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/7dcc593c3afa93da8ceaef5e55bcf10e1aac1fab.png

The OST will include many extended tracks versus their in-game counterparts, and are off to mastering today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/d83384284aa314548591aa403ab9c9e5744df1cb.png

We initially said the demo and the soundtrack would release in September 2023. That unfortunately won't be possible as the soundtrack needed a bit more time. 

We're aiming for mid October for both, we'll be able to confirm this later. The soundtrack page should be live soon and  In the meantime you can listen to small bits of it here:

[previewyoutube=rfkCRyxY_2g;full][/previewyoutube] 

or here:

[previewyoutube=SbABBcP_SkE;full][/previewyoutube]

There's more on our YouTube channel, don't hesitate to browse all videos!

In other news regarding the demo, saving will be disabled. This is mainly due to a technical problem that prevents the demo saves and the final game from working correctly together. As there is not elegant solution at hand and our resources are limited, the decision was made to remove the save feature from the demo altogether. Should you find yourself in need of stopping midway, know that the skip feature still works, and that all seen text can be skipped. Obviously the rollback feature also still works fine.
In a more positive light, the demo is about 45 minutes long and contains a handful of choices already. All progress that triggers achievements will be transfered to the full game, so there's that.
See you soon!

notes.title: Ready for Release!
notes.notes: The final week to release is here at last. It's been a long journey to get to this point, and we can't wait to get the game into the hands of the community. We will release several videos over the course of the next days to give you some previews of what it contains.
